text: {"observations": [{"unit_ids": ["D7823eee481.P003.S001"], "anchor": "The UK, at the request from the US, supported this operation as part of global efforts to crack down on sanctions-busting and shadow shipping activity.", "reason": "Does participating in sanctions enforcement operations against shadow shipping reduce sanctions-busting and its revenue effects?"},{"unit_ids": ["D7823eee481.P031.S001", "D7823eee481.P032.S001", "D7823eee481.P033.S001"], "anchor": null, "reason": "How effective are sanctions on shadow fleet vessels at reducing sanctioned states' oil revenues and shipping capacity?"},{"unit_ids": ["D7823eee481.P066.S001", "D7823eee481.P066.S002"], "anchor": null, "reason": "What are the costs and security benefits of deploying a multinational force to support Ukraine's defence capabilities post-ceasefire?"},{"unit_ids": ["D7823eee481.P072.S001"], "anchor": null, "reason": "Does long-term provision of armaments and security guarantees deter future armed aggression against Ukraine?"}]}
